name: episode_id
description: Episode this row belongs to; ep_<sha256(ref)[:16]> for trigger-born episodes

name: stage
description: Policy ladder stage name (policy pack owned)

name: session_id
description: Harness session that most recently armed this checkpoint - normally the one that recorded it; a crash re-fire overwrites it with the new session. Joins agent_executions.session_id

name: policy_status
description: Deterministic policy result: pass | fail | insufficient_evidence

name: report_md
description: Full stage report embedding the epistemic record (DLP-scrubbed)

name: next_check_at
description: Human-readable schedule decision label ('+Nm', policy vocabulary); next_check_delay_seconds is the numeric companion. Both NULL = the ladder ended

name: next_check_delay_seconds
description: The decided delay in seconds - exactly what defer_verification was armed with. Due time = TIMESTAMP_ADD(completed_at, INTERVAL next_check_delay_seconds SECOND). NULL = ladder ended

name: exported_at
description: Snapshot upload time (microsecond precision); the *_latest views key on it

name: export_phase
description: ladder_complete (final verdict recorded) | outcome_final (re-export after ground-truth labeling)

name: export_session
description: Harness session that ran the export
